name: Zitadel
description: Zitadel is an open-source identity and access management platform. It provides single sign-on over OpenID Connect, OAuth 2.0 and SAML, passkeys and multi-factor authentication, and multi-tenancy through organizations, with every change kept in an audit trail.

app_vars.name: var_zitadel_login
app_vars.label: Login UI
app_vars.help: v2 is Zitadel's default since v4: a separate login app, served together with the API over HTTPS on port 8080 with a self-signed certificate. v1 is the classic login built into the API, over plain HTTP. Updates keep the choice

notes.text: Sign in at /ui/console as zitadel-admin@zitadel.localhost with the initial password from ~/zitadel.creds in the container. Zitadel asks for a new password at the first sign-in.
With Login V2 (default) Zitadel runs at https://<IP>:8080 with a self-signed certificate; accept it in the browser. Login V1 stays on plain http://<IP>:8080.

Zitadel only answers on the ExternalDomain in /opt/zitadel/config.yaml (the container IP). To use a hostname, change it, run zitadel setup --masterkeyFile /opt/zitadel/.masterkey --config /opt/zitadel/config.yaml and restart zitadel.
